name: Spine-Chilling Story of Abnormal Ramen
source:
This horror story with elements of slice of life is about two high school students, Maya and Yan. After trying some strange noodles by accident, they find themselves drawn into exploring a deep, abandoned building where weird ramen is cooked. 

Where they ended up was the result of their past mistakes and weaknesses. Will they be able to come to terms with what they once did, or will they remain at the bottom of the deep ramen ocean forever?

[From [url=https://re-caff.itch.io/abnormal-ramen]itch.io[/url]]
